description: Registry of executable capabilities. Every entrypoint is a public function in uiux.api; adapters call tools only through uiux.api.call_tool or the unified CLI (python scripts/uiux_cli.py call <id>). When passing parameters via CLI on Windows, prefer --params "@path/to/params.json" to avoid shell quoting issues. `input` is the JSON Schema subset enforced by uiux.core.schema before every call. `output.required` lists the top-level keys every successful result contains. `annotations` are platform-neutral upper bounds over all argument values: read_only, writes_to (none|target-project), may_start_process, deterministic, network_access, filesystem_read (package|target-project|browser-cache), requires_node, requires_browser, long_running.

tools.description: Phase 7 – Run a complete runtime validation session (critique + repair loop). Accepts a modification plan, change manifest, before/after evidence. Returns a critic_report with overall_status (pass/warn/fail/blocked), categorised issues (visual_regression, preservation_violation, responsive_failure, interaction_failure, accessibility_regression, runtime_error, plan_drift, missing_required_state), pre-existing vs new regression classification, repair recommendations, and repair history.

validate_only.description: If true, no repair attempts are made.

output.description: critic_report: {schema_version, report_id, session_id, plan_id, workflow, overall_status, summary, issues, repair_recommendation, repair_history}

tools.side_effects: none (pure analysis; does not write evidence or apply repairs)

tools.description: Phase 7 – Build a critic report from a pre-assembled session data dict (use when you already have all session components). Returns critic_report.

session_data.description: Dict with modification_plan, change_manifest, before_evidence, after_evidence, workflow, session_id.

tools.description: Phase 7 – Evaluate a critic_report for overall pass/fail/blocked status. Returns authorized_to_proceed flag and key metrics.
Phase 7 – Build a targeted repair plan from a critic report. All repair actions are validated against Phase 6 blast radius. PRESERVATION_VIOLATION and PLAN_DRIFT issues are never auto-repairable.
Phase 7 – Execute a targeted repair plan through Phase 6 Controlled Editing scope gate. Repairs bounded to original blast radius. Scope violations are blocked.
tools.side_effects: none (plan-level; actual code edits performed by agent via controlled editor)

tools.description: Phase 7 – Compute the minimal targeted evidence recapture surface after a repair. Never full-site for local component fixes. Returns recapture_plan with pages, viewports, scenarios, provenance.

output.description: recapture_plan: {recapture_pages, recapture_viewports, recapture_scenarios, is_full_site, rationale, provenance}

tools.description: Fast health check of the installed package: version consistency, manifest, tool/knowledge/error registries, public API entrypoints, capability map, error contract and runtime detection. A missing optional runtime is reported as BLOCKED, not as a failure.

output.description: {status: PASS|FAIL, version, checks: [{id, status: PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED, message, error_code?}]}

tools.side_effects: none (reads the package; runtime detection runs `node --version`); never installs, downloads or writes

tools.description: Run full Repo & Framework Intelligence to produce a normalized repo_profile (framework, styling, routes, components, tokens, UI state).
Analyze an existing UI codebase for visual identity, layout hierarchy, component consistency, UX flows, responsive health, and design system maturity.

Map the frontend structure of a project: routes, the layout shell around the page slot, ordered page sections with role (hero, features, pricing, ...), content inventory (headings, actions, media, fields), layout pattern and signature, motion, default-banlist signals and generic density, components and tokens in use. Focus: React/Next.js + Tailwind; Vue, Svelte, Astro and HTML templates with less precision. Save the result as .uiux/ui-map.json before an Elevate change.

options.description: routes (list of paths), max_routes (30), max_depth (4, component expansion), detail ('full'|'summary'), markdown (bool: add a CURRENT-UX-MAP section inventory), files/file_contents/package_json (in-memory project)

output.description: UI map: {schema_version, framework, styling, shell, routes[{path, file, layouts, sections[{id, order, role, pattern, layout_signature, content, fingerprint, motion, banlist}], page_banlist, generic_density, fingerprint}], components, tokens{declared, used}, summary, limits}

tools.side_effects: none (read-only static scan of the project)

tools.description: Compare a before and an after UI map (map_ui_structure): routes and content items removed or added, sections re-composed per route, banlist signals resolved, introduced or remaining, and whether the Elevate bar is met (content preserved and at least half of the matched sections re-composed).

after.description: UI map captured after the change

output.description: {routes_removed, routes_added, routes[{path, content_removed, content_added, sections_recomposed, recomposition_ratio, pattern_changes, banlist_resolved, banlist_introduced, banlist_remaining}], content_preserved, recomposition_ratio, elevate_bar}

tools.description: Rank the React + Tailwind / Next.js code recipes (knowledge/code-recipes) for each section of a UI map from map_ui_structure, or for given roles: fits by section role and by the default-banlist signals each recipe replaces, plus token, motion and surface recipes with their dependency status (available, needs_install with the command to propose, or css_fallback). Never installs anything.

banlist.description: Signal ids when no ui_map is given

tools.description: Score a visual change for the critique loop (review/visual-critique.md): validates the independent critic's rubric JSON for the after (and before) state, computes the weighted score, applies measured gates from diff_ui_maps, run_runtime capture probes (layout_probe, motion_probe) and accessibility scans, and returns pass, iterate (with next_focus) or stop, plus a VISUAL-CRITIQUE markdown section.

previous_score.description: Weighted after-score of the previous iteration (no-progress detection)

output.description: {verdict: pass|iterate|stop, reason, score{after, before, delta, progress}, dimensions, criteria, gates, issues, next_focus, markdown}
